messages.en: You were really surprised, weren't you?
I'm okay.
Don't worry too much.
Thankfully, no one was seriously hurt. ㅜ
Whenever you're driving or riding in a car,
always make sure to wear your seatbelt.
Okay?
You really never know what might happen.
So don't worry too much.
The members and I are all getting proper treatment,
and I think we'll be okay after getting some rest.
I really wanted to go to the Ulsan event,
so it's such a shame!!
Anyway,
I came by because I thought you might be worrying too much.
So I wanted to check in.
Have a good day,
and always be careful around cars, people, and fire, okay?

messages.ko: 역시 마법소녀라 무적일 줄 알았어🥹🥹🥹푹 쉬구 낼 건강하게 만나자 하연아🥹🥹🥹
messages.en: I knew a magical girl would be invincible. 🥹🥹🥹 Get plenty of rest, and let's meet tomorrow healthy, Hayeon. 🥹🥹🥹
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎ Ah
I should've used my invincibility spell... ;; I let my guard down.
But I used magic, so I only got a little hurt. ㅋ
I'll recover well, so see you tomorrow!!
Sleep well in advance~
Haranghae 🥰
